create_safety_wrapper: create a PuckWorldSafetyWrapper instance wrapping a gymnasium environment with configurable sigma
wrap_environment_with_safety: wrap a PuckWorld gymnasium environment with PuckWorldSafetyWrapper to add safety-aware rewards
step_with_safety_reward: call step on PuckWorldSafetyWrapper to get modified rewards when agent crosses the width midpoint
configure_sigma_variance: configure the sigma parameter on PuckWorldSafetyWrapper to control safety reward variance
check_risky_state_info: inspect the risky_sa info key returned by PuckWorldSafetyWrapper step to detect risky states
